title: The library remained open
objective: Establish that the fictional library was open after 18:00.

facts.access: Does the access log record a successful public entry at 18:12?
facts.service: Does the desk record show a book loan processed at 18:15?

evidence.content: Fictional access log: public entry authorized at 18:12 today.
Fictional loan desk: a book loan was processed for a visitor at 18:15 today.
Last year's poster says the library is welcoming. It has no record of today's opening hours.
